_description: Historical block bootstrap with 5-year blocks. Each run stitches two random 5-year slices of the 1928-2024 series to fill a 10-year horizon. Tests that returnModel='historical_bootstrap' draws blocks reproducibly under a seeded RNG and uses simulationSettings.numSimulations as the run count.
_rationale: Pure accumulation: $500k Roth, no spending, no income, zero parametric inflation. With block size 5 and horizon 10, every run is exactly two stitched blocks. Each block is drawn uniformly from the 93 valid start indices (97-5+1 each). 1000 runs averaged across many possible block combinations should yield a 60/40 real CAGR similar to the rolling test (~3-7% range). probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance. Median final balance lands in the same broad band as the rolling test plus extra block-stitching variance.
name: Historical Bootstrap 5-yr blocks
